scope: Read-only source review before root decision. No archive payload hash/decompression, process scan, test, app, Docker or relocation executed.
checked: Only fixed historical42597a/c593 source pair is replaced; current333/7caf paths have metadata-only protection and are not write targets; no current760/fixture mutation path.
Original pair requires same complete metadata/dev/inode, nlink2, current UID, mode0600, and exact size; both historical receipt identities and expected full archive SHA must agree.
TMP initially requires entire copy size plus500MiB floor+64MiB guard; guard remains during copy and each replacement/final validation.
Initial durable intent precedes copying; source hash/pair checks and full copy+readback hash precede publication/replacement; mode,mtime,uid,gid preserved for retained copy.
Each source replacement has durable intent and temporary link; link target has already been verified and original pair retained until then.

Failures retain partial artifacts and journal, do not hide rollback/deletion, and explicitly require exact source-link inspection after interrupted replace/fsync. A recorded replacement list may lag an actual atomic replace, which is not claimed complete.
Final target hash/size, protected333 metadata and original receipt hashes are checked before passed=true.
limits: Root-controlled build-settled/no-use window is an asserted operational prerequisite, not independently observed by this script/reviewer.
180-second bound is cooperative between reads/operations; synchronous I/O/fsync requires the separate outer bound if a hard limit is intended.
Protected333 parity covers metadata only, not new content hashing. No direct current760 metadata receipt or global state census is provided; those paths are outside mutation scope.
Free space is sampled sequentially, may change concurrently, and is not a future admission guarantee. At most one copy block is written between guard samples, inside the separate64MiB guard.
Target on TMP preserves exact bytes and compatibility paths at this operation, not guaranteed environment snapshot persistence or original inode/hardlink topology.
This review does not validate actual copy/operation outcome or claim root free-space gain.
suggestedTinyControls: Pair identity/nlink mismatch refuses before replacement
Wrong copy hash or existing target leaves both original hardlinks intact
Failure after first atomic replacement leaves verified target plus remaining original and an explicit incomplete record
Post-copy mode/metadata and low-TMP guard checks remain enforced
